notes: This fixture is the ONLY place either allowlist below may be edited. hooks/sessionstart-tool-enum.mjs loads it at runtime and never hardcodes an entry inline -- see src/policy/tools/central-classification.ts's header comment for the full disclosure, including runtime expiry enforcement.

centralLayer.tools[].class is presence-only / inert today (GitHub Issue #93) -- no consumer reads it before S6's real central policy ships. Classifying a tool here only removes it from SUR-03's unclassified/halt set; it does not itself drive any enforcement decision.

knownConnectors is a pure display-name string match against ~/.claude.json's claudeAiMcpEverConnected array -- spoofable in principle, NOT a real security control. Ships only because the human explicitly reviewed and accepted this exact risk (see 'ratifiedBy' above), dated and time-boxed via 'expiresOn' to force renewal. Never silently rolled forward: past expiresOn, both allowlists in this fixture stop being applied automatically at runtime.
